params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items returned per page

params.name: page
params.description: Which 'page' of paginated results to return.

items.docs: To list all of the keys in your account, send a GET request to `/v2/account/keys`. The response will be a JSON object with a key set to `ssh_keys`. The value of this will be an array of ssh_key objects, each of which contains the standard ssh_key attributes.

To add a new SSH public key to your DigitalOcean account, send a POST request to `/v2/account/keys`. Set the `name` attribute to the name you wish to use and the `public_key` attribute to the full public key you are adding.

params.name: ssh_key_identifier
params.description: Either the ID or the fingerprint of an existing SSH key.

items.docs:
To get information about a key, send a GET request to `/v2/account/keys/$KEY_ID` or `/v2/account/keys/$KEY_FINGERPRINT`.
The response will be a JSON object with the key `ssh_key` and value an ssh_key object which contains the standard ssh_key attributes.

params.name: ssh_key_identifier
params.description: Either the ID or the fingerprint of an existing SSH key.

items.docs: To update the name of an SSH key, send a PUT request to either `/v2/account/keys/$SSH_KEY_ID` or `/v2/account/keys/$SSH_KEY_FINGERPRINT`. Set the `name` attribute to the new name you want to use.

params.name: ssh_key_identifier

items.docs:
To destroy a public SSH key that you have in your account, send a DELETE request to `/v2/account/keys/$KEY_ID` or `/v2/account/keys/$KEY_FINGERPRINT`.
A 204 status will be returned, indicating that the action was successful and that the response body is empty.
